units.source_text: 我没有回复，却不禁扭头看了看大寺院。

en.t: I did not answer, but I could not help turning my head to look at the great temple.

units.source_text: 大寺院那高耸的塔和圆屋顶像无数的触角般地伸向阴郁的天空，

en.t: The great temple's towering spires and round domes reached toward the gloomy sky like countless feelers,

units.source_text: 周围弥漫着一种恐怖的气氛，和出现在沙漠的天空上的海市蜃楼并无二致……

en.t: and a fearful atmosphere hung all around, no different from a mirage appearing in the desert sky...
